meta.name: Snoopy Presents To Mom and Dad With Love
meta.description: Mother's Day is almost here, and the gang is excited—except Peppermint Patty. For her, it's a reminder that she didn’t grow up with a mom. But good pal Marcie helps Peppermint Patty see that families come in all shapes and sizes.
meta.slogan: For the ones that hold it all together.
